goal.name: General health check
goal.blurb: Equal weight on the eight design pillars. The default when no particular goal has been set.

signals: signals were too weak or too close to call (landing 0.35)

scoreBasis: Scored against 43 criteria in scope for a page of undetermined type, under the "General health check" goal. 31 of them could be judged from this audit; the rest need a reviewer and are listed as tasks rather than counted either way. Every pillar carries equal weight. Each pillar scores the share of its judged criteria that passed, with a partial counting half.

reviewerTasks.task: Submit each form and press each slow control, and note whether anything changes within 400ms.
reviewerTasks.why: People assume the click failed and press again, which produces duplicate submissions and duplicate charges.

reviewerTasks.criterion: One task is built one way
reviewerTasks.task: Pick one task that appears on several screens and record how each screen implements it.
reviewerTasks.why: People build a model of how the product works. Breaking it makes them relearn the same task in each new place.

reviewerTasks.criterion: Labels match the words people use
reviewerTasks.task: Compare the navigation labels with the words customers use in support tickets, search logs or interviews.
reviewerTasks.why: People scan for the word they already have in mind. A clever internal name is invisible to them.

reviewerTasks.task: List the nouns and verbs used for each object across the main screens, and mark where they disagree.
reviewerTasks.why: Calling the same object a project, a workspace and a board teaches people that they are three things.

reviewerTasks.task: Load the main views on a throttled connection and record what each shows while waiting.
reviewerTasks.why: An empty panel and a slow panel look identical, so people reload or leave.

reviewerTasks.task: Complete each main action in a test account and record what the product says afterwards.
reviewerTasks.why: Without confirmation people repeat the action or go looking for proof it worked.

reviewerTasks.criterion: Restricted and permission states are designed
reviewerTasks.task: Open restricted areas with a lower-privilege account and record what is shown.
reviewerTasks.why: A blank screen where a permission is missing reads as a bug, and arrives as a support ticket.

reviewerTasks.task: Read the main screens aloud and mark terms a new customer would not know.
reviewerTasks.why: Copy written for the team rather than the customer is read as noise and skipped.

reviewerTasks.task: Collect the copy from the main screens and compare voice across them.
reviewerTasks.why: A playful empty state next to a formal error reads as two products stitched together.

reviewerTasks.task: Read INP from field data (Chrome UX Report or your own analytics); a single lab visit cannot establish it.
reviewerTasks.why: Past 200ms an interface feels sluggish rather than broken, which is harder to report and easier to abandon.
